subject: Recursive proof compounding law: every epoch must make the next epoch cheaper, safer, or more informed

law: Every meaningful epoch closes with zero or more typed outputs: SolvedInvariant, KnownNonCause, RegressionFence, FactorValidityEnvelope, DeletionProof, TraceDivergence, capability discovery, or new WorkGraph obligation.
ContextCompiler must preferentially inject the smallest still-valid proof/invariant set needed by the next task instead of replaying transcript history.
Projection Kernel must derive views from canonical evidence/state; agents must not hand-maintain duplicate status prose when a projection can compute it.
WorkGraph deduplicates by causal obligation + bound inputs, not title text. Repeated observations attach evidence to the existing obligation unless inputs invalidate it.
A RegressionFence is executable: bind it to tests/queries/receipts that fail when the solved defect returns.
KnownNonCause must actively prune future search space and provider blame, not remain archival metadata.
Every new TraceDivergence must either spawn reconciliation work or explicitly bind to an already-open obligation.
Proof/frontier reuse must be visible in receipts as avoided epochs/provider calls/bytes so compounding can be measured.
body.anti_amnesia_target: Make ProofFrontier/SolvedInvariant/KnownNonCause/RegressionFence the default terminal shape for converged work, not a special FPQ-only feature.
